text:
Like dwarfs and monkeys along the border
of a tapestry in which you strode,
drunk, pursuing young women...
Or like the faithful, attending
—while you enchanted us—
the holy sacrifice of fame
for your excessive intelligence,
that was what we all were to you. Your life
was wasted labors of seduction.

And your good poems, lures
after the revelry to keep us there.

translation.title: Through the Mirror
